notes: This contract defines portable C++ and Java TCK witnesses for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.13.5's requirement that the RID support alternative configuration of the RTI address and port. The adapter supplies a TLS RTI Address with a numeric port other than the normative TLS default 15165 and a matching TLS 1.3 listener. The scenarios connect through the official APIs and complete List Federation Executions with its report callback. They test the externally observable configured endpoint only; they do not establish certificate-policy completeness, independent-provider interoperability, or provider-wide conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador::connect using an RtiConfiguration RTI Address with an explicitly configured non-default port, followed by List Federation Executions and its report callback
